# Prowess Software Services

> Integration and data architects for the AI-native enterprise. Two-time MuleSoft Above & Beyond Partner of the Year — Americas (2024 and 2025). 350 certified architects across four offices: Atlanta, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Singapore.

Founded 2016 by Aravind Konda (CEO) and Ajay Konda (CGO). 175+ customers across 25+ industries. Named customer references include Novelis, CEVA Logistics, Syncron, Keystone Logistics, Pacific International Lines, Rich Products, and ADT.

## EnterpriseFLOW products (fixed-fee)

- [EnterpriseFLOW overview](https://www.prowesssoft.com/products/): four accelerators, $150K–$500K
- [Migration Sprint MuleSoft](https://www.prowesssoft.com/products/migration-sprint-mulesoft/): TIBCO, Boomi, IIB, webMethods, BizTalk → MuleSoft. $200K–$350K, 12–24 weeks. X2M + CurieTech AI Migration Agent.
- [Migration Sprint Informatica](https://www.prowesssoft.com/products/migration-sprint-informatica/): PowerCenter, DataStage, SSIS, Talend → IDMC + MDM. $200K–$350K, 12–20 weeks.
- [Agent Fabric Builder](https://www.prowesssoft.com/products/agent-fabric-builder/): MuleSoft Agent Fabric in 6 weeks. $150K–$300K. Two pilot agents, governance, observability.
- [Implementation Accelerator](https://www.prowesssoft.com/products/implementation-accelerator/): Anypoint Platform standup + operating C4E by day 90. $300K–$500K, 16–28 weeks.
